### Fixed
- **The image-verification egress names the registry's blob storage** (giantswarm/agent-platform#599, the live check of 4.44.3). The registry redirects a blob read — the Sigstore bundle's layer — to an Azure Storage account (`<account>.blob.core.windows.net`), not to a dedicated data endpoint: with 4.44.3's allow-list Kyverno's admission controller got past DNS and the registry and stopped at `failed to fetch referrer layer: Get "https://<account>.blob.core.windows.net/…"`, every model pod still denied. `modelServing.imageVerification.kyvernoEgress.hosts` defaults to `*.blob.core.windows.net` in place of `*.*.data.azurecr.io` (a registry with dedicated data endpoints names that pattern itself), mirrored in both charts; `make verify-model-serving-policies` holds the default list.
